why: Source: read four revenue and four staff values off gridlines, four divisions, average (about 4 steps); question: the same gridline readings, four divisions and average (about 4 steps), only the series differ.

Source: pick the max-minus-min measure, four subtractions with negative signs, rank (about 4 steps); question: the same measure choice, four subtractions with two negatives and ranking (about 4 steps).
Source: locate the right chart and bar, triple the base, two percentage-of-count calculations, difference (about 5 steps); question: the identical chain on a different criterion (about 5 steps).

Source: four statement checks (two annualised growth rates compared, two period growths, a share of total, a ten-year projection), about 5 steps; question: the same four statement types reordered, about 5 steps.

Source: annual profit from daily customers, monthly-to-annual cost, net, ROI, then decide on direction of the threshold (about 5 steps); question: the same ROI chain, after which D fails on the number and A and B fail on direction, leaving C (about 5 steps, with the same left-out-monthly-cost trap).
Source: five labelled ratio divisions and a ranking with one close pair (about 3 steps); question: five labelled divisions and a ranking with one close pair (about 3 steps).

Source: annual profit, monthly-to-annual cost, net, ROI, decide on direction (about 5 steps); question: the same ROI chain, after which C fails on the number and B and D fail on direction, leaving A (about 5 steps, same trap).
Source: locate five accounts in two twelve-bar charts, five divisions, rank with two close comparisons (about 4 steps); question: the identical structure with two close comparisons (about 4 steps).
Source: two FTE-times-hours calculations, hours-to-minutes conversion, two per-unit divisions, difference (about 5 steps); question: the identical chain with new numbers (about 5 steps).

Source: five revenue-per-transaction divisions from the table and a ranking with two close calls, ignoring the one-year-value chart (about 3 steps); question: the same five divisions, distractor chart and ranking with close calls (about 3 steps).
